messages:
Lin: Heads up, we're seeing mTLS failures from ap-east -> eu-north since 11:05 UTC. Proxy logs show 'x509: certificate signed by unknown authority' and 'handshake alert 40'.
Omar: Any recent IAM/KMS changes in eu-north?
Lin: Yes — infra/iam PR 3310 trimmed principals on CMK alias/ephemeral-eu. It removed region-scoped role `arn:aws:iam::444:role/egress-eu-north`.
Lin: Patch excerpt:
```
-    "Principal": { "AWS": ["arn:aws:iam::444:role/egress-eu-north", "arn:aws:iam::444:role/legacy-rotator"] }
+    "Principal": { "AWS": ["arn:aws:iam::444:role/legacy-rotator"] }
```
Greta: If egress can't call KMS:Decrypt to unwrap ephemeral private key material, the proxy can't present trusted certs -> CA unknown errors.
Omar: @kms-audit-bot pull decrypt::Denied events for alias/ephemeral-eu 10:55-11:10 UTC.
kms-audit-bot: audit summary:
- 11:02:07 UTC decrypt::Denied principal=arn:aws:iam::444:role/egress-eu-north reason=NotFoundInPolicy req=aaa-101
- 11:03:30 UTC decrypt::Denied principal=arn:aws:iam::444:role/egress-eu-north reason=NotFoundInPolicy req=aaa-102
- 11:08:10 UTC decrypt::Allowed principal=arn:aws:iam::444:role/egress-eu-north req=aaa-250 (after revert)
Lin: Revert PR 3311 applied at 11:07:55 UTC.
Greta: Immediate mitigations: 1) revert policy (done), 2) enable proxy fallback to cached certs for 20m, 3) create alert rule: >3 decrypt::Denied for alias/ephemeral-eu in 5m -> page infra+seceng.
Omar: Long term: require KMS policy removals to include a staging smoke test that exercises unwrap via the proxy (example: `kubectl exec proxy -- curl https://proxy.internal/health -H "x-test-unwrap: true"`), and add a checklist item to PR template: "Does this change affect CMK principals?"
Lin: I'll file SEC-5555 (RCA + audit excerpts), INFRA-901 (staging unwrap test), and IAM-318 (policy-change gating + 2 approvers).
Greta: Also record incident window and affected regions in SEC-5555 (11:02-11:08 UTC, ap-east->eu-north). Attach KMS audit snippets and proxy logs.
Omar: One find: the PR removed a principal that is deployed only in eu-north; global cleanup assumed it was unused. Let's add a short script to cross-check policy removals against active service instance tags before pruning.
Lin: Good call. I'll add INFRA-902 (policy-prune safety check).
Greta: Closing thread — thanks for quick revert and audit checks.
